method: Compile both Python fences, execute the hand-written control-flow demo, and run the LangGraph example in an isolated Python 3.14.7 virtual environment with langgraph==1.2.14. Inspect final graph state, next nodes, metadata step, and final in-memory checkpoint values. Compare persistence and graph semantics against official LangGraph documentation.
limitations: The LangGraph example is deterministic and makes no model call or external side effect; it validates only the displayed API path and state summary.
InMemorySaver restart loss is supported by the official documentation; this run did not terminate and restart a separate process to test persistence durability.
The review covers LangGraph 1.2.14 only, not a cross-framework capability survey. Transitive Python dependencies were resolved during installation and were not captured in a lock file.
No production database saver, durability mode, external side effect, model/provider, concurrent graph writes, or deployment configuration was exercised.
